name: bookstore
description: Authors and books with nested listing, ISBN as the key, no auth and cursor pagination.

input.title: Bookstore API
input.requirements: A public bookstore catalogue. Authors have an id, a name and an optional born year. Books are identified by their isbn and have a title, an author_id and a price (not negative). Clients can list and create authors, fetch one author, list the books of one author, list and create books, fetch a book by isbn and replace a book.
